login.title: Welcome back!
login.subhead: Please enter your credentials to access your account.
login.newPasswordRequiredSubhead: You signed in with a temporary password. Please create a new permanent password for your account.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we will send a verification code.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.description: Enter your email, verification code and your new password.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: For security, enter your current password to set a new access key.
changePassword.error: Could not change password. Please verify that your current password is correct.
changePassword.requirementNumberOrSymbol: At least one number or symbol

register.title: Register
register.subhead: Create a new account to get started.

error.title: Federated login error
error.sessionRefreshFailed: We could not restore your session after federated login.
error.permissionRefreshFailed: We could not load your permissions after federated login.
error.unregisteredUser: Your email account is not registered or enabled on this platform. Please request access from an administrator.

expiredSession.title: Session Expired
expiredSession.description: Your security session has expired or is invalid.
expiredSession.inactivityDescription: You have been inactive for a while. For security reasons, please log in again.

notAuthorized.title: Access Denied
notAuthorized.description: You do not have permission to access this section.

accountPending.defaultDescription: Your account has not been activated in the system yet. Once a coordinator approves your profile, you will be able to access the platform.

PENDING_FORM.title: Pending S-73 Form
PENDING_FORM.description: Your account has been registered, but approval or submission of your S-73 form is pending to enable your access.

PENDING_CAPACITATION.title: Pending Training
PENDING_CAPACITATION.description: Your registration was received and is awaiting scheduling or completion of your training session.

IN_TRAINING.title: In Training Process
IN_TRAINING.description: You are currently in your training period. Your full credentials will be enabled once completed.

REJECTED.title: Application Not Approved
REJECTED.description: Your application to participate has not been approved at this time. Please contact your local coordinators for more details.

INACTIVE.title: Inactive Account
INACTIVE.description: Your account is currently inactive in the platform. Please contact your coordinator to request reactivation.

activate.title: Activate your account
activate.description: Create a secure password to complete access to your account.
activate.requirementNumberOrSymbol: At least one number or symbol
activate.backToLogin: Already have an active account? Sign in
activate.loadingDescription: Please wait a moment while we verify your invitation.
activate.alreadyActiveDescription: You have already established your password. You can now access the platform with your credentials.
activate.expiredDescription: The activation link has expired (24-hour validity). Please request a new link to continue.
activate.invalidDescription: The activation link is invalid, has been revoked, or was not provided.
activate.networkErrorDescription: We could not validate your link due to a connection or server problem.
activate.missingTokenDescription: No valid activation token was found. The link may have expired or is incomplete. Please request a new invitation or contact your administrator.
activate.successDescription: Your password has been successfully established. You can now access the platform with your credentials.
activate.errorGeneric: An error occurred while activating your account. Please check your credentials or try again.
